description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Rajawaka, Balangoda D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No.620042  (25/5514034)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 1:9 of Block 06) in Rajawaka, including detailed land particulars, ownership details, and cadastral information. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters.
